data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that synchronizes a ScrollView and a custom tab view.
data.what_it_does: Synchronizes a vertical ScrollView with a custom tab view so that scrolling updates the active tab index, and tapping tabs scrolls the list to the corresponding section. It exposes both Scrollbar and CustomScrollView parameters.
use_when: You need a settings or catalog screen with category headers that automatically highlight the corresponding tab as the user scrolls.
You want to combine a SliverAppBar with a TabBar that tracks scroll position.
avoid_when: You only need a standard horizontal tab view without scroll synchronization.
You are using a non-scrollable layout.
strengths: Synchronizes tab views and scroll positions out of the box.
Exposes standard Scrollbar and CustomScrollView parameters.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Requires explicit management of both TabController and AutoScrollController.
List items must be provided as a List<dynamic> type.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding vertical_scrollable_tabview and scroll_to_index to pubspec.yaml.
